title: HIS MERCIES ARE NEW
LAMENTATIONS 3:22-23
end: The Praise Garden — enter His gates with thanksgiving

scenes.a: If you woke up carrying the heavy fear that your strength will run out today, listen.
It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
Father, we offer You our heartfelt thanks that Your love does not depend on our perfection.
Before our feet touch the floor, Your fresh mercy is already waiting for us.
When our mind feels overwhelmed, remind us that Your divine compassion never fails. We rest in Your constant care today. Subscribe to The Praise Garden to walk in daily prayer with us.
